context: Editorial remaining real chapter-editor/file UI in16 locales: titles, upload/add/remove actions, CUE/TXT limits, timeline help, minimum2 chapters, unreadable-file failure, custom/generated drafts. Terminology matches reviewed include-chapters checkbox and chapter validation. Exact CUE/TXT/512KB identifiers preserved; provider/file contents/names untouched. Source Start is deliberately excluded because its shared verb/column contexts need separate treatment.
